public_shadow_smoke.interpretation: The safe smoke reached the public endpoint but the returned ticker schema was rejected. It produced no simulated entries and cannot provide forward performance evidence.

limitations: Historical bid/ask is unavailable from the endpoint, so spread is an explicit assumed half-spread, not observed quote history.
The six runs use bounded 240-candle windows. They establish negative evidence, not broad regime coverage.
Funding readiness passed for every claimed real-funding run, but the funding records are venue history sampled for the evaluated window and do not prove complete lifetime coverage.
The older windows are designated untouched holdout periods, but the strategy has no parameter-fitting stage in this evaluator, so statistical confidence and parameter stability remain unproven.
Safety scan remains FLAGGED for quarantined signed-request code and sensitive local artifacts. No such path was invoked.
